gap.title: Bare-free T = 0: a bipartite 4-cycle-free graph's AND/OR edge-function circuit with no mixed OR, every edge served by a star OR, has >= |E| + tau - 1 gates
gap.statement: ∀ (p l : ℕ) (E : Finset (Fin p × Fin l)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ (a a' : Fin p) (b b' : Fin l), a ≠ a' → b ≠ b' → ¬ ((a, b) ∈ E ∧ (a, b') ∈ E ∧ (a', b) ∈ E ∧ (a', b') ∈ E)) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (p + l) C → (∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (p + l) C x = decide (∃ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E ∧ x (Fin.castAdd l a) = true ∧ x (Fin.natAdd p b) = true)) → PEqualNP.TwoColour.tCount (p + l) C (fun i => decide (p ≤ i)) = 0 → (∀ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E → (∃ (j : ℕ) (Q : Finset (Fin l)), j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ 2 ≤ Q.card ∧ b ∈ Q ∧ (∀ b' ∈ Q, (a, b') ∈ E) ∧ ∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (p + l + j) false = decide (∃ b' ∈ Q, x (Fin.natAdd p b') = true)) ∨ (∃ (j : ℕ) (P : Finset (Fin p)), j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ 2 ≤ P.card ∧ a ∈ P ∧ (∀ a' ∈ P, (a', b) ∈ E) ∧ ∀ x : Fin (p + l) → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD (p + l + j) false = decide (∃ a' ∈ P, x (Fin.castAdd l a') = true))) → ∃ S : Finset (Fin (p + l)), (∀ (a : Fin p) (b : Fin l), (a, b) ∈ E → Fin.castAdd l a ∈ S ∨ Fin.natAdd p b ∈ S) ∧ E.card + S.card ≤ C.size + 1
gap.unlocks: a case of the class bound that looks within reach tonight: every edge delivered through a star OR
gap.context: SKETCH: A ledger, sketched and not yet written out in full. A star OR for the edge (a, b) is an OR of at least two lines all adjacent to a; with no 4-cycle two points share at most one line, so such an OR has exactly one centre a. Count three disjoint kinds of gate: the OR gates that build the star ORs, at least the sum over centres of (leaves minus one); the AND gates that join a centre to its star OR, at least a vertex cover since every edge is served; Size: 3 hours. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
